title: Verify allowlist/{email} before provisioning users/{uid} and surface accessDenied in SignInGate

violation.problem: AuthProvider in studio/src/lib/auth-context.tsx immediately sets `user`, calls `upsertUserProfile(...)`, and attaches `onSnapshot(userRef(nextUser.uid), ...)` before verifying that `allowlist/{email}` exists, without an async session guard (`loadSessionRef.current++`). Non-allowlisted users mount the signed-in app shell with rejected Firestore writes, and SignInGate tells users 'New here? Continuing with Google creates your account.' with no allowlist denial message.
violation.expectedSolution: Add `isEmailAllowlisted` in `studio/src/lib/users.ts` (reading `doc(db(), 'allowlist', email.trim().toLowerCase())`), guard async auth resolution in `AuthProvider` with `loadSessionRef.current++`, check `isEmailAllowlisted(nextUser.email)` before setting `user` or calling `upsertUserProfile`, call `await signOut(auth())` and set `accessDenied: true` when not allowlisted, and render the allowlist denial state in `SignInGate`.

forbiddenPatterns: New here? Continuing with Google creates your account.
